zh.text: Waller總裁為12月50個基點加息打開了大門。然而，此觀點未獲回應；即使FOMC的鷹派也不真正支持。偏好似乎是更頻繁的25個基點加息。

en.text: Governor Waller opened the door to a 50bp rate hike in December. However, this view has fallen on deaf ears; even the hawks on the FOMC are not really open to the idea. Preference seems to be 25bp rate hikes spaced closer together.

zh.text: 我不知道老兄。你有上升的通脹、爆炸的赤字、利率和伊朗戰爭災難在你的盤子上。不如專注於那些？

en.text: I dunno man. You have rising inflation, exploding deficits, interest rates, and the Iran war debacles on your plate. How about you focus on those?

zh.text: 全球宏觀最偉大的圖表：政府債務與勞動力參與率呈反比。人口老化時增長放緩，因此政府債務上升。

en.text: Greatest chart in global macro: Government debt is the inverse of the labour force participation rate. As population ages, growth slows, so government debt rises.

zh.text: 30年期日本政府債券收益率升至4.025%，上升2.5個基點

en.text: 30-Year Japanese Government Bond Yield Rises to 4.025%, Up 2.5 BPS

zh.text: 今晚DXY仍在上升，這是大規模1.5萬億美元IPO前的金融緊縮表現。展示DXY（左）和SPY（右）的圖表。

en.text: DXY is still going up tonight, representing financial tightening ahead of a massive $1.5T IPO. Shows charts of DXY (left) and SPY (right).

zh.text: 這個週末我在Costco加油花了4.25美元，不記得上次是這個價格了..至少在西海岸這很便宜lol。原油圖表在日線上也熊旗，如果這些油價跌破85的月度價值區域，年底可能有順風。

en.text: I filled up my tank for $4.25 this weekend at Costco, cant remember last time that was the price.. at least on west coast thats cheap lol. Crude Oil chart bear flagging on daily also and a potential tailwind into year end if these oil prices crack under 85 monthly value area.

zh.text: 特朗普希望全面改革美國空中交通管制系統，因一次路由器升級導致週五全國地面停止。FAA已獲得125億美元，特朗普還想要多300億美元。Hanke批評華盛頓對每次失敗的解決方案就是更多金錢。

en.text: Trump wants an overhaul of the U.S. air traffic control system after one router upgrade caused Friday's nationwide ground stop. FAA has already received $12.5 billion, and Trump wants $30 billion more. Hanke criticizes Washington’s solution to every failure as more money.

en.text: 3PeaksTrading expects gap fill after Korean traders sell post-Kospi open. Prefers weakness ahead of NVDA and VIX expiration Wednesday for reverse higher into OPEX and holiday week as VIX deflates. ES_F key levels: 7642 VAH, 7529 VAL, POC 7599.
